changes.value: Quickly burrow to the target location without requiring vision. The Deep Tunnel upgrade does not require a Hive.
Requires Deep Tunnel research at an Infestation Pit.
Deploys the Void Seeker, granting friendly units within radius 16 of the target location Super Cloak for 15 seconds. Does not transport Zeratul.

Spawns a tornado that lasts for 5 seconds and affects enemy ground and air units within radius 1.25. It deals 5 damage every 0.25 seconds and reduces movement and attack speed by 30%. These effects linger for 1 second after leaving the tornado. Does not affect structures.
Circular splash around the target: full damage to ground and air enemies within radius 1.5. Slows enemy movement by 70%.
